profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, powering AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with innovative semiconductor solutions. Its website highlights mobile memory and storage that accelerate AI-driven technologies, along with design tools, data sheets, a Technology Enablement Program (TEP), and sales support.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, trading under the ticker MU. Its SEC CIK is 0000723125. Idaho law exposure records list 21 entries for the company. No litigation cases or MCP servers are recorded.
